verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs say it automatically categorizes transactions using transaction details, history, and team feedback, then syncs the coded transactions to the ERP. It also claims an AI auto-coding agent, invoices coded to the right GL account, and ERP sync that eliminates manual journal entries. Multi-entity support is documented separately, so AI coding across entities is implied rather than shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation that AI GL coding applies per entity in multi-entity setups, independent or hands-on corroboration of coding accuracy and time saved at close, and in-depth first-party docs beyond marketing claims.
